lines.en: Oh, Ross, can you stop at the coffee house and get me a muffin?
Please, take your time. It's an important decision.
Not like, say, I don't know, deciding to marry someone.
Wow, he's really not letting this go, is he?
Oh, God, how long do you think that's going to last?
Well, I don't know. He got over the we were on a break thing really quickly.
